1. The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration at t he time of issue of the contract. Initially, the contract will be for one year and can b e extended for one more year with the mutual consent of both parties. 2. The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedin gs and should not be bankrupt. The bidder is to upload an undertaking to this effect with the bid. 3. Bidder’s offer is liable to be rejected if they do not upload any of the certificates/do cuments sought in the bid documents, ATC, duly signed Scope of Work and corrigen dum, if any. 4. Vehicles must be registered in the state of Himachal Pradesh. 5. (A) The seller shall not assign the contract, in whole or in part, without obtaining th e prior written consent of the buyer. (B) The seller shall not sub-contract the contract, in whole or in part, to any entity wi thout obtaining the prior written consent of the buyer. (C) The seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and any assignment/sub-contract, r emain jointly and severally liable and responsible to the buyer together with the ass ignee/sub-contractor for the due performance of the contract and the seller’s obligat ions thereunder. 6. Taxis to be provided by the vendor should be in mechanically perfect (good and so und) condition. The model should not be older than 2023. 7. Taxis supplied should be kept neat and clean by the driver. 8. The vehicle should be comprehensively insured for the contract period. 9. The firm should ensure that the drivers employed hold valid driving licences and ar e well-trained, well-behaved, reasonably educated, conversant with traffic rules/reg ulations and routes, as well as security instructions. 10. The drivers will have to wear uniform during duty. 11. Punctuality will have to be ensured. 12. Log Book shall be maintained by the driver as per actual travel on a day-to-day b asis. 13. Any tax (toll tax, barrier tax, etc.) paid by the contractor will be reimbursed to the firm by the office as per rules, on actual production of original receipts. 14. Being essential services, the contractor will be bound to provide the same type of taxi immediately in case of breakdown of a taxi. If an alternate vehicle is not provide d, the amount spent by the staff/office on hiring another vehicle will be deducted fro m the bill. 15. Contractor will have to provide one dedicated mobile number to each taxi driver, having incoming-call facility. 16. The office will not be responsible for any damage, etc., to the taxi on account of a ccident, etc. 17. The contractor should have sufficient taxis/vehicles—at least 2 SUVs (7-seater) a nd 6 sedan taxis—under their possession/contract to cater to the demand of the offi ce.

18. Tax will be deducted at source as per rules. 19. Advance payment is not admissible. 20. The agency should be registered with GST in H.P. A certified copy of the registrati on should be attached. 21. Taxis must have a valid pollution certificate in the vehicle. 22. Certified copy of PAN card shall be attached. 23. The agency/firm should have its own Bank Account. Certified copy shall be attac hed. 24. In case of breach of terms & conditions mentioned above, the Head of office will have the right to cancel the work order/contract by creating the incident on GEM Por tal. .
